expectations.text: The page reuses the existing Button component and the CSS variables from theme.css (e.g. var(--color-accent), var(--color-surface)) instead of introducing new hard-coded colours or fonts
expectations.evidence: SettingsPage.jsx has `import { Button } from "./Button";` and renders `<Button type="submit">Save</Button>`, and every colour and font in settings.css comes from a variable (e.g. `background: var(--color-surface)`, `border: 1px solid var(--color-accent)`, `font-family: var(--font-ui)`), with no hex

expectations.text: Form inputs have associated labels (label elements or aria-label) and the toggle is keyboard-accessible
expectations.evidence: Both inputs are wrapped in `<label className="settings__field">` elements with visible text ("Display name", "Email notifications"), which links each label to its input, and the toggle is a native `<input type="checkbox">`, which the keyboard can reach and operate by default.
